newsitem.title: SPAIN: EMU jitters could delay Spain rate cut - Argentaria.
newsitem.headline: EMU jitters could delay Spain rate cut - Argentaria.

text.p: Spain's central bank could delay a reduction in its key money market rate given recent jitters on the European economic and monetary Union, according to a research report published by Argentaria on Friday.

"The decisions that may came out of the Ecofin's monthly meeting and the Amsterdam EU summit could lead the Bank of Spain to delay cutting the official rate until the impact of those measures was known," the report by the Spanish bank said.
The study said market uncertainty had increased after a Bonn-Bundesbank standoff over gold revaluation and the election in France.
Without those factors, the Bank of Spain could have approved a reduction by 25 basis points in its official rate after the announcement of May CPI on June 13.
Argentaria is expecting Spanish inflation to slow in May to 1.4 percent year-on-year from 1.7 percent in April.
